title: Concise Provider List
shortDescription: The Concise Provider List export option streamlines the results in a .csv file by including only one row per provider regardless of the number of locations and specialty groups that a provider may be part of.
body:
The **Concise Provider List** export option streamlines the results in a .csv file by including only one row per provider regardless of the number of locations and specialty groups that a provider may be part of. The information in this .csv export will match the information you see in the UI on the results Provider List page.

To select this export option, click on the **Export** button on the Provider List (detail results) page that can be accessed through Create a List, Compare Networks, Competitive Dashboard, Accessibility, or Adequacy modules. A dropdown list of export options will appear with Provider List Details selected by default. 

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/consice-export.png)

Select the **Concise Provider List** option and click on the **Export CSV** button.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider-list2.png)

**Note:** When you choose the **Concise Provider List** option, you will no longer see options to include the Networks, Tags, Provider comments, and Custom attributes as these are not part of a Concise Provider List.  If you want to see this information, continue with the **Provider List Details** export option.

Here is an example for the downloaded CSV file which includes only one row per provider, regardless of the practice locations or specialty groups, matching the information displayed in the UI on the results Concise Provider List page.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider-list3.png)
